script: Inside a MacBook Air, two hundred and five sensors are quietly measuring heat.
Thermal Map reads every one of them. Live.
Each reading sits on the part it measures. The chip. The heat sink. The battery.
And a model of how heat moves fills in the space between.
Put it under load, and watch the heat rise from the M3, and spread.
Or look at the outside, the way a thermal camera would.
Thermal Map. Free, and open source.
